purpose: R1.17 — Phase 5E-1: the first real event-relation + decision-persistence slice, exactly per the owner attachment and nothing more. (1) CANDIDATE RETRIEVAL — the deterministic UNION of the fingerprint-discovery candidates of the SAME lookup moment (zero new fingerprint probes) with shared-entity candidates from ≤3 ordered probes of idx_story_entities_entity(entity_id, story_id) (≤9 rows each, ORDER BY story_id ASC before LIMIT, overflow probed honestly, unprobed entities recorded, ≤8 unique candidates, origin labels fingerprint:<signal>/entity:<id>); smallest-ID selection is a cost cap, never a best-candidate claim; no candidate ≠ unrelated. (2) BASIS — each candidate resolves through its OWN ready draft's durable document record (readReuseDocumentBasis) PLUS the bridged original reference row whose content_hash must match the recorded snapshot identity; missing/legacy/stale bases are TYPED basis_unavailable with the reason — never silently skipped, never a different-event verdict. (3) BUNDLES — ≤2 pairs (erp-1/erp-2), side texts from REAL stored text only (side A: this item's composed text; side B: the candidate draft's immutable sourceReport excerpt), total ≤16 KiB UTF-8 checked (never silently truncated), canonical input hash over BOTH bases (incl. the candidate draft's exact document-bytes hash and reference identity) + prompt/policy version; side ids never mixed even on name collisions. (4) THE SEPARATE event_relation AI TASK — own immutable prompt pixel-event-relation-v1 (untrusted-data framing), own strict output schema (one verdict of same_event_proposed/different_event_proposed/insufficient_evidence; ≤4 bounded reasons; references valid from BOTH sides required for the two *_proposed verdicts, EXPLICITLY contracted for insufficient_evidence; foreign refs/self-pairs/wrong pairIds/merge-trust-HTML command fields/incomplete-oversize JSON rejected via .strict() + explicit checks) — over the SAME durable budget authority (authorizeAiRequestAttempt scope 'ai', the SAME per-provider daily caps, usage only reported), the SAME allowlist ladder (Workers AI primary; Gemini stays unverified/unwired), terminal per-pair safety refusal, typed deferrals, NO paid fallback; ≤3 REAL provider attempts for the WHOLE step shared across pairs (never per pair), ONE 15 s wall deadline bounding budget waits + calls + validation; late rejections absorbed; noncancellable charges stay honest; drafting keeps its own deadline and respects the REMAINING budget. (5) DURABLE STORAGE — the versioned eventRelation ledger rides INSIDE document_json of the SAME fenced draft INSERT: pair identities, basis hashes/ids/versions, the proposed verdict OR the typed non-evaluation state, citations (both_sides/none_reported/partial), prompt/policy versions, REAL provider/model, REAL deterministic aiRunIds (aiRunIdForRelationAttempt(job, generation, pair, attempt) — never colliding with the news_draft run or another pair/attempt), caps/coverage, beyond-capacity candidates; deterministic metadata only (no raw side text, no self-referential SHA); typed reader readEventRelationDecision enforces the REAL invariants (ascending candidates, evaluated shape, NO verdict inside failure states, run-id shape, counts ≡ Σ pair aiRunIds, fixed caps/coverage/limitations) — a payload that merely claims the version is malformed; drafts.ai_run_id stays the news_draft run. (6) SQL PROTECTION — every statement of the commit batch additionally carries the candidate-basis gate (each evaluated pair's side B: ready draft at the pinned version with the EXACT document bytes AND the bridged reference identity/hash, evaluated INSIDE the batch; ≤2 bases → ≤12 extra params, heaviest statement ≤35/100; empty lists keep 1 = 1 so every accepted path is behavior-identical); one invalidated basis zeroes EVERY statement → typed eventRelationBasisChanged (distinct from catalogChanged/fenceLost/snapshotChanged/contentTaken) → REAL runs (drafting AND relation) recorded honestly via the standalone fenced insert, no refund, no stale verdict, bounded engine retry; ≤3 event_relation ai_runs statements settle ATOMICALLY in the same batch (zero on disabled/no-candidate paths). (7) FLAG — EVENT_RELATION_ENABLED ('true'|'false', default 'false') is an INDEPENDENT fail-closed gate in ALL environments (wrangler root+preview, .env.example, .dev.vars.example, parseAiConfig); it NEVER implies AI_ENABLED or EDITORIAL_ENABLED (both OFF); disabled ⇒ the honest disabled ledger with ZERO relation SQL/calls/writes and the accepted normal path byte-intact. REUSE BOUNDARY — every accepted exact reuse/replay path returns BEFORE the relation step (zero extra retrieval/model/charge/write; historical/reused drafts never enriched); the C1 catalog-gate re-resolve path re-commits the SAME provider draft with the SAME deterministic relation run ids (no duplicates) and the relation basis gate rides along. SEMANTIC BOUNDARY — verdicts are MODEL PROPOSALS over named evidence, never truth/probability/merge authorization; shared signals never count as confirmation; conflicts (numbers/times/negations) stay recorded conflicts; technical states never become semantic insufficient_evidence.
